name: Whirlseed · Gremlet #29
description:
A maple seed that spins like a helicopter. Loves high places and dramatic exits.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Whirlseed in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
